# stalwart_mta_stage_ehlo (Resource)

Configures EHLO command requirements and validation. This singleton object always exists: creating the resource adopts the current server settings and destroying it only removes the resource from state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `reject_non_fqdn` (Attributes) Whether to reject EHLO commands that do not include a fully-qualified domain name as a parameter (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--reject_non_fqdn))
- `require` (Attributes) Whether the remote client must send an EHLO command before starting an SMTP transaction (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--require))
- `script` (Attributes) Which Sieve script to run after the client sends an EHLO command (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--script))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned identifier.
